description:
Compact OpenAPI description for the public YNAB v1 API. Covers the read-oriented
endpoints most useful for personal finance snapshots, audits, and purchase decisions.

tools.name: budgets_get
tools.description: Get one budget. Required: budget_id. Optional: last_knowledge_of_server. Returns the GenericResponse.

params.name: budget_id
params.description: Budget ID. Use 'last-used' to access the last used budget.

params.name: last_knowledge_of_server
params.description: Delta request marker returned by previous responses.

tools.name: budgets_accounts_get
tools.description: Get one account. Required: budget_id, account_id. Returns the GenericResponse.

params.name: budget_id
params.description: Budget ID. Use 'last-used' to access the last used budget.

tools.name: budgets_accounts_list

params.name: month
